equilibrium.interpretation: Reconstructed from QF-assembled M/K and QF checkpoint states; descriptive internal consistency only.

classification_and_indicators.interpretation: The geometric/load checks and oracle truncation guard are executable invariants. The physical discretization, beam-correlation, residual and energy indicators do not create a PASS threshold or qualify the whole dynamic route.
physical_indicators_without_acceptance_t: Newmark time-step difference on the same mesh
dynamic residual, support reaction reconstruction, force/moment balance and energy/work drift
pre_run_invariants: all linear TET10 corner volumes are positive
both physical probes are exact nodes
quadratic face integration represents area 0.01 m2, +100 N at unit factor, and zero end-face-centroid moment
GlobalAssembler nodal load matches the generated face load to absolute 1e-13 N per nodal component
assembled resultant and centroidal moment satisfy the absolute 1e-12 N and N m checks
all time grids contain 0, 10, 20 and 80 ms physical knots and the requested duration
time histories, residuals, energies and reference arrays are finite

model.boundary_conditions: All UX/UY/UZ translations fixed at x=0; all other solid translations free; no rotational solid DOFs.

notes: Same-QF-M/K modal-oracle comparisons diagnose Newmark time integration only. All reported physical mesh and Euler-Bernoulli differences remain exploratory; no general dynamic qualification is asserted.

reference.known_limits: Beam theory omits shear deformation, rotary inertia, 3D clamp boundary layer and the cross-section discretization. It is a mechanical comparison, not an exact 3D-solid solution.
reference.type: independent continuous Euler-Bernoulli cantilever modal series
